source_value_text: 50 s (in vivo half-life of K17F in rat blood circulation after i.v.)
source_quote: The in vivo half-life of K17F in the rat blood circulation is 50 s following i.v. administration
source_location: Introduction, para 4; Discussion para 2 ('previously reported ... 50 s for K17F, in SD male rats after i.v.')
route_quote: These results are in line with the previously reported in vivo LIT01-196 half-life of 28 min in the bloodstream, versus 50 s for K17F, in SD male rats after i.v. administration.
notes: Value is cited from earlier work, not measured in this paper; no phase, dose or method given in this body text. 50 s = 0.0139 h.
